steps.content: "Keep your distance, and do not harm her." This was the only order you gave the guards before you leave.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But after all, she's able to suppress the Black Ring with her illusions...
I will never do anything that goes against the MBCC's stance. Do you trust me on this?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Of course.
Then please trust my judgment too. I'll find a solution that works for both the MBCC and Hamel.
Between resisting and self-sacrifice, she's always chosen the latter.
Going back to the stage and dancing what she wants to dance. That's the only choice she's made for herself. I hope to help her achieve that.
Based on the location sent back by the guards ahead, Nightingale, you, and the others finally catch up with Hamel at around 1 kilometer from the Carnival.
The guards who've arrived beforehand have been following Hamel. Because of your order, they've been keeping a distance without taking any further actions.
She seems unable to hear any other sound, her mind fixed on making her way to the Carnival unhurriedly.
Hamel, I already know what you truly desire. You want a stage that will accept you, right?
She still doesn't turn back.
Hamel!
The Rust is covered in sewage and mud, but none of these has soiled Hamel's feet.
Like a ghost who's eager to be home, she's floating slightly, approaching the remains of the Black Ring, the true appearance of the ruins now revealed.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: It's useless...
The familiar shadow is blocking your way.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: She just wants to go back there. No one can stop her.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: No one...
As the phantom finishes, an indigo illusion is immediately filling your sight.

Everyone is being engulfed in the deep sea-like illusion. The phantom rises in the air, and the illusion is expanding rapidly, sealing every corner of the road as well as completely blocking Hamel's figure ahead of you.
It's you again... You're the embodiment of Hamel's negative emotions, aren't you? What are you going to do this time?

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: I won't let you guys near her.

options: I only want to help her.

choices.text: I only want to help her.

steps.content: I saw her past in my dreams. I completely understand her feelings of wanting to return to the Carnival.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: Haha, you understand...

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: Do you know how many people have lied to her like that? I've already stopped believing...
"Swish!" Before you have time to object, the phantom attacks you without any warning.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, watch out!
Nightingale shoots in time, the bullet and the tentacle canceling out each other's impact.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: You've got a good adjutant. You've also got so many subordinates who obey you, and those Sinners... They all see you as a friend and agree with your decisions...

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: But what about Hamel?
The phantom is drifting left and right, its tone sometimes sad and sometimes angry.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: Hamel doesn't have family who understand her nor friends who appreciate her.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: Worse still... She only knows the DisCity 23 years ago. She doesn't even know a single place in the present DisCity.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: You have eliminated the Corruptors, removed all her audience, and now... all she has left is the Carnival...
The phantom closes in on you once again, and Nightingale instantly aims her gun at it.
Although the Jellyfish with its severe speech before you has a completely different character than Hamel, it's essentially the vessel of all of Hamel's negative emotions.
Behind its words, perhaps there lie Hamel's thoughts that she has never expressed.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: Sorrow, brokenness, fragility. Such is the DisCity's future, a prophecy of beauty, it is everything she perceives!

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: You can never bind the dancer's limbs. You can never silence her over the beauty she sees. You can never put her back into the cage!

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: The dancer must return to the stage!!!
And with that, the phantom begins spinning on the spot. At the same time, the indigo illusory realm starts twisting and transforming with it as well.
The spinning surroundings make you sick at once.
I'm not trying to capture her...

The phantom doesn't spare you any chances to explain. The illusory realm is expanding further, so that now on top of the tormenting vision, a voice like a croaking siren has also joined in, worsening your dizziness.
You're not the only one being affected. The guards, and even Nightingale, are all suffering from dizziness and nausea.
Buzz! A familiar sting surges from the shackles again. Something new is happening.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I've come back to dance for you. Do you still remember me?
Facing the empty ruins of the Carnival, Hamel smiles nostalgically. Meanwhile, outside the Carnival, large crowds of loitering Corruptors are looking up at the sky.

steps.speaker: Wandering Corruptor
steps.content: Hamel... Dance... Tell the story... for us...
They keep repeating Hamel's name and moving slowly in the same direction.

You can't wait any longer. Whether it's to stop the Corruptors from converging on the Carnival or for the sake of Hamel's mental stability, you must finish off this damned jellyfish as quickly as possible.
It wasn't my intention to fight you, because you've said you're part of Hamel. I don't know if harming you will cause any side effects in her.
But since you can't calm down and listen to me, I can only force you into cooperating with me.

You reach out your right hand. The shackles spill out a crimson gleam in your palm, but it turns into deep sea foam the moment it touches the phantom. <color=#fb9259>The shackles don't work on it?</color>

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the foam is only an illusion. Its power has gotten significantly weaker. If you try once more, this time it must...!

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: Shut up! I won't let anyone stop Hamel!
As it's speaking, it leaps in the middle of the air. The black illusion expands and stirs the air, lifting everything around it in the air.

The innocent participants of this battle have all been whirled into the illusory realm, amid rubble, debris, and illusions... Besides you who stand in the center, everything is spinning with the phantom's illusory realm.
The foam envelopes your hand and once again devours the shackles' red light. The phantom is standing before you.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: Do you really understand her? Can you really accept her? Then what are these shackles in your hands for?
The shackles also serve to suppress her Mania and prevent her mental state from getting worse.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: But the illusions brought by Mania is a part of the soul of her dance!
That's why I must go there! Compared to the Corruptors who will only worsen her Mania and her mind, I'm a better audience, because I can prevent accidents with the shackles.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: You... you're not here to capture her?
I'm here to take her back, but more importantly, I want to try to make her wish come true.

She wishes for audiences who can appreciate her dance of sadness. Stop manipulating the Corruptors, I'll be her audience instead. No matter what kind of world she perceives, as long as it's Hamel's dance, I'll watch it, I'll appreciate it.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: No ulterior motive, no plan to use her, no coercion? You will always let her dance the way she wants to?
Of course.
She can dance to her heart's content.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: To her heart's content...
The jellyfish-like shadow is expressionless, but you can tell it's lowered its guard.
This time, there are no more illusions disturbing you. The red spikes are spreading all the way out of your palm.
Hamel has always considered others' feelings first and buried her most pressing wishes in the deepest corner of her heart, leaving them to pile up there.
Confusion, perplexity, and loneliness... Still, I need to thank you, for letting me see her nightmares, so I could help her put those thoughts into words.
The shackles' spikes and the phantom become entangled with each other, and with a slight tug, it becomes a cloud of black smoke.

As the phantom vanishes, the indigo illusory realm is gradually fading as well. After snapping out of the dream in the middle of the night and chasing your way here in the dark, you realize it's already dawn outside the illusory realm.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, do you really have to go on your own?
All those who got whirled up in mid-air have been gently lowered back onto the ground.
Hamel has never thought of hurting anyone. Even the embodiment of her most extreme and negative emotions has never caused any loss to the MBCC.
Don't worry, I've got the shackles with me, I'll be fine. I got out of the Carnival when the Black Ring was still active, why would I get trapped by these ruins?
Before I come back out, you guys stay here and stand by.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But...
Your adjutant is still worrying about you.
Don't forget you've promised to trust my decisions on our way here.
I'm only going to see a dance. Once the show ends, I'll bring back the dancer and make sure she's well and conscious.
